def check_equation(a, b, c):
    """Checks if (a+b+c)(ab+bc+ca)+a+b+c = 16abc"""
    S1 = a + b + c
    S2 = a*b + b*c + c*a
    S3 = a * b * c
    LHS = S1 * S2 + S1
    RHS = 16 * S3
    return LHS == RHS
